The Callaway Quantum Max irons are engineered to deliver powerful ball speed, consistent carry, and reliable forgiveness across the face—combined with a refined, modern profile that inspires confidence at address. Designed for golfers who want added control without sacrificing forgiveness, Quantum Max helps produce cleaner strikes and more predictable results throughout the set.

Built with advanced cavity-back technology, AI-optimised face design, and progressive sole shaping, these irons provide a balanced blend of speed, stability, and feel to support confident iron play.
members.more:
Key Technologies & Benefits

Modern 360° Undercut Cavity An advanced two-piece cavity-back construction with extreme perimeter weighting and a fully exposed undercut delivers faster ball speeds, higher launch, and increased forgiveness across the face.

Next Generation AI-Optimized Face Callaway’s AI-engineered face design enhances ball speed while producing more consistent launch, spin, and dispersion by expanding the effective hitting area based on real-world impact patterns.

Progressive Tri-Sole Design Sole geometry evolves throughout the set to promote cleaner turf interaction, improved speed retention, and consistent contact from long irons through wedges—even on heavy strikes.

Urethane Microspheres Strategically placed microspheres absorb unwanted vibration at impact, improving sound and feel for a softer, more forged-like sensation in a high-speed game-improvement iron.

Refined, Confidence-Inspiring Shape A clean, modern head profile blends forgiveness with control, delivering consistent performance for golfers seeking improved scoring and reliable iron play.

members.intro:
The Callaway Apex CB Golf Irons are crafted with precision using a 5-step forging process and 1025 carbon steel for a soft and responsive feel. Its one-piece design and precisely placed MIM weights provide superior balance and workability. Take your golf game to the next level with these top-of-the-line irons.

A progressive CG design allows for optimised trajectory control. The long irons boast a lower CG, providing expansive shots that land softly on the greens, while the short irons feature a higher CG for lower trajectories and additional spin control. The Dynamic Sole Design ensures better turf interaction, with a slightly worn leading edge that glides through the turf and trailing edge relief for improved exit. This combination results in a sole that maintains ball speed and ensures reliable contact with all shots.

Boundless Innovation. Infinite Potential.

Sleek Black Finish

The Forged Black edition combines modern design with timeless elegance, reducing glare and creating a bold, premium aesthetic that performs as beautifully as it looks.

Fitting & Custom Options

  • Custom Shafts: Choose from top-tier options including KBS, Nippon, Project X, and Dynamic Gold.

  • Custom Grips: Wide range of Golf Pride, Lamkin, and Winn grips available.

Why Players Love the JPX 925 Forged Black

members.intro:
Mizuno Pro S-1 Irons Pure Muscle Back Precision with Unmatched Feel

The Mizuno Pro S-1 Irons represent the pinnacle of forged craftsmanship — pure muscle backs designed for players who demand ultimate precision, control, and workability. Every detail has been meticulously engineered to deliver the soft, responsive feel that defines Mizuno’s heritage of performance excellence.
members.more:
At their core lies the renowned Grain Flow Forged HD process, expertly executed in Hiroshima, Japan, using a single billet of 1025E Pure Select Mild Carbon Steel. This forging method creates the legendary Mizuno feel — buttery smooth through impact, with unmatched feedback and control. A copper underlay subtly refines vibration patterns, enhancing the soft, solid sensation for which Mizuno irons are revered.

Key Technologies & Design Features

Grain Flow Forged HD Construction

  • Forged from 1025E Pure Select Mild Carbon Steel for superior consistency and feel.

  • Crafted in Mizuno’s Hiroshima facility for precision and heritage-level quality.

Copper Underlay

  • Adds a rich, responsive feel by fine-tuning vibration frequencies at impact.

Channel Back Design

  • Redistributes mass to enhance vertical stability and promote a more consistent centre of gravity.

  • Developed with input from Mizuno’s tour professionals for precision performance.

Harmonic Impact Technology

  • Tunes the club’s vibration frequencies to create Mizuno’s purest, most satisfying feedback.

Refined Sole Geometry

  • Compared to the Mizuno Pro 241, the S-1 features:

    • Flatter camber

    • Sharper leading edge

    • +1° additional bounce

  • Results in smoother turf interaction, greater forgiveness on shallower swings, and reduced digging.

Features & Specifications

  • Grain Flow Forged HD for premium feel and precision

  • Soft, responsive touch with copper underlay

  • Sleek, compact head with thin topline and sole

  • Straighter lines for a clean, tour-inspired profile

  • Standard Grip: Golf Pride MCC Black/Grey

  • Warranty: 1-Year Manufacturer’s Warranty

Pure feedback. Total control. Iconic Mizuno feel. The Mizuno Pro S-1 Irons are crafted for the purest ball strikers — those who appreciate artistry, precision, and performance in every swing.

The most forgiving iron in the Signature Series - without giving up the Mizuno feel.

The Mizuno Pro S-4 is built for accomplished golfers who want the unmistakable feel of a forged Mizuno iron with genuinely more forgiveness behind it. A redesigned curved muscle pulls mass lower into the head, while progressive offset, a wider sole and a deeper centre of gravity combine to launch the ball higher and hold it straighter on strikes away from the middle.
members.more:
Mizuno Pro S-4 Golf Irons

It sits alongside the S-1 muscle back and the S-3 split cavity in Mizuno's Signature Series - the choice for the accomplished player who wants a classic profile at address with a wider margin for error.

Every head is Grain Flow Forged HD in Hiroshima, Japan from a single billet of 1025E Mild Carbon Steel, with a copper underlay beneath the finish and Harmonic Impact Technology tuning the vibration through the head. That's the reason these irons feel the way they do at impact, and it hasn't changed.

Key Technology

Grain Flow Forged HD: Forged in Hiroshima from a single billet of 1025E Mild Carbon Steel for exceptional feel, feedback and consistency.

Redesigned Curved Muscle: Concentrates mass lower in the head to deliver higher launch, greater stability and increased forgiveness, while keeping the classic Mizuno Pro profile at address.

Progressive Head Geometry: Increased offset, a wider sole and a deeper centre of gravity inspire confidence at address while making the ball easier to launch.

Triple Cut Sole: Bevelled leading and trailing edges move the head cleanly through the turf on entry and exit, improving strike across a range of lies and conditions.

Copper Underlay: A copper layer beneath the outer finish further softens the responsive feel synonymous with Mizuno Pro forged irons.

Harmonic Impact Technology: Head vibration is deliberately tuned to produce the solid, refined sensation expected from a premium Mizuno forging.

Loft, Lie and Length

Who Are They For?

The S-4 is a players iron, not a game improvement iron. Mizuno position it for golfers in the 0-8 handicap range. If you already strike the ball well and want a forged Mizuno with a little more help on off-centre hits, this is the one. If you're looking for a bigger, more forgiving head with more ball speed, the JPX range is the better starting point.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does the S-4 compare to the S-3? The S-4 is the more forgiving of the two. It carries more offset, a wider sole, a lower sweet spot and a deeper centre of gravity, which makes it easier to launch. The S-3 is the more compact, tour-focused head.

What shaft comes as standard? This set is built with the stock True Temper Dynamic Gold Mid 115 in Stiff flex, with the stock Golf Pride Z-Cord grip.

Are the S-4 irons forged? Yes. Every head is Grain Flow Forged HD in Hiroshima, Japan from a single billet of 1025E Mild Carbon Steel.

What is the 7-iron loft? 34 degrees - a traditional players-iron loft rather than the stronger lofts found in distance irons.
